LAREDO — A 28-year-old man was booked into the Webb County Jail on Friday afternoon on a third-degree felony assault charge, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Jose Cuauhtemoc Gonzalez was arrested on October 23, 2026, at 4:23 p.m. The booking record lists the charge as assault of hospital personnel — a third-degree felony under Texas law — and bond had not been set as of booking.

The booking record does not list an arresting agency.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Update — October 24, 2026

Webb County court records for the case behind the arrest, 2026CRD000832D3 in the 341st District Court, show the case was filed June 10, 2026, on a third-degree felony charge of assault of hospital personnel, with an offense date of November 12, 2024. At a second arraignment on October 15, 2026, the defendant did not appear; the court issued a failure-to-appear warrant as to Counts I and II and granted the State's request for a no-bond capias and judgment nisi, with Judge Rebecca Palomo presiding. A further arraignment hearing is set for October 29, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. The charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records (Case 2026CRD000832D3, 341st District Court).
